channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11A
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11A (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11A: The name now says what the place is: The City's…
item.description: The name now says what the place is: The City's draft parks agreement calls P10, P11 and P11A "Open Space Parcels", and the official parcel code is kept in the name. No source read gives the parcel a proper name of its own. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: City draft Agreement for Maintenance and Operations of Mission Bay Parks and Open Spaces, 22 Sep 2023 draft (https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/21383/Item-5f-Attachment-A-Mission-Bay-Parks-Agreement-DRAFT-101923), section 5(a), page 6: "P10, P11 and P11A are Open Space Parcels that are and will remain within PW jurisdiction as public right of ways".

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11A: OCII's September 2023 presentation lists P11/11A…
item.description: OCII's September 2023 presentation lists P11/11A among the parcels Recreation and Parks "will manage", with transfer planned by the end of December 2023; it does not say the median was complete. No source read gives its completion date. Source: https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf ; https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/r0574-23.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11A: The P11A page now cites a September 2023 draft…
item.description: The P11A page now cites a September 2023 draft Mission Bay parks maintenance agreement that lists P11A among the parks completed and accepted (a draft, so it may differ from the signed text, and it gives no opening date), and says its description of the island (landscaped with grass) is Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery. item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11A: The P11A median's map shape cited no sources
item.description: The P11A median's map shape cited no sources. It now lists the OCII Dec 2019 Land Use Map (P11A labeled just east of the circle) and the OCII Sep 2023 transition presentation ('P11/11A' among parcels Rec & Park will manage). The summary and map notes said the median sits west of the Parklab Gardens soccer field; OCII's Nov 2024 update puts the SFF soccer field on P12 and Parklab Gardens on P15, so the wording now says the P12 soccer field. 'Already managed' became 'will manage' to match the deck, the P-number note now cites the 2019 map and 2023 deck instead of saying it rested only on our own identification, and the citation to Pier & Point's own mapping notes is labelled as such. The Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural, and the OCII deck's title no longer says 'CAC Item 2' (that came from its file name). Source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation, 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf); OCII, Remaining Mission Bay Open Space Parcels Update, Mission Bay CAC, 2024-11-14 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf).
item.source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation, 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf); OCII, Remaining Mission Bay Open Space Parcels Update, Mission Bay CAC, 2024-11-14 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf)

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11A: Listed as 'P11/11A' among the parcels… (~Sep 2023)
item.description: Listed as 'P11/11A' among the parcels RPD "will manage" (not among the 'when built' parcels) in OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation, with the open space to transfer "by the end of December 2023" (an expected date). This is a plan; it does not say the median was complete or when it was built (~Sep 2023). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (sfocii.org), 2023-09.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (sfocii.org), 2023-09
